neighbours.label: reversal of direction or order: 'the other way (around)', 'the reverse', 'in reverse'
fire: Most people think stress causes poor sleep, but it can work the other way around too.
The pump moves water uphill during the night and does the reverse during the day.
Instead of reading the list from top to bottom, she read it in reverse.
If you know the area, you can rearrange the formula and solve it the other way.
The chemists showed that the reaction can also run in reverse at high temperature.
Translate the sentence into French, then translate it back the other way to check it.
Usually the teacher asks the questions, but today it was the reverse.
We assumed the dog was chasing the cat, but it was the other way round.
quiet: Most people think stress causes poor sleep, and doctors often agree with that view.
The pump moves water uphill during the night and rests during the day.

If you know the area, you can use the formula to find the length of a side.

notes: Top examples peak on ' way' in 'the other way', ' reverse', 'flip it around'; output promotes reverse/backwards. Probe: 'opposite direction' read only 0.13, so the test leans on 'other way' and 'reverse'.
